LESSON: WRITING 6.5.1 COMMONLY MISSPELT WORDS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.5: Writing 6.5.1 Commonly Misspelt Words
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 6.5.1 Commonly Misspelt Words, part of Strand 6 in Grade 7 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How can we improve our spelling?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. mention words that are difficult to spell correctly,

2. work with peers to search for commonly misspelt words from textbooks and online sources,

3. discuss ways of correcting commonly misspelt words,

4. correct texts with wrong spellings of irregular plural nouns, for example, knife-knives; ox-oxen; fox-foxes; child- children; thief-thieves; lady-ladies; monkey-monkeys, and –ing verbs formed from verbs with final –e for example love – loving, dine – dining,

5. explain to peers the effects of correct spelling on written communication,

6. engage in spelling games such as crossword puzzles,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. mention words that are difficult to spell correctly,
2. work with peers to search for commonly misspelt words from textbooks and online sources,
3. discuss ways of correcting commonly misspelt words,
4. correct texts with wrong spellings of irregular plural nouns, for example, knife-knives; ox-oxen; fox-foxes; child- children; thief-thieves; lady-ladies; monkey-monkeys, and –ing verbs formed from verbs with final –e for example love – loving, dine – dining,
5. explain to peers the effects of correct spelling on written communication,
6. engage in spelling games such as crossword puzzles,

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 6.5.1 Commonly Misspelt Words together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication: It is enhanced as the learner writes clearly and spells words correctly.

• Collaboration: It is developed as the learner respects the opinion of peers when discussing ways of correcting commonly

misspelt words.

Values

Respect is enhanced as the learner explains to peers the effect of correct spelling.
